stops.name: Capo Caccia

stops.name: baia di Porto Conte
stops.detail: the boat excursion, which departs from the port of Alghero towards the bay of Porto Conte, during which the characteristics of the coastal environment of the protected area are illustrated.

stops.name: casa Gioiosa
stops.detail: the visit to Casa Gioiosa, headquarters of the park authority, where it is possible to view illustrative panels of the environmental characteristics of the protected area and the educational laboratories of the environmental center;

stops.name: punta Giglio
stops.detail: the visit to Punta Giglio, through a trekking path that goes into the Mediterranean scrub until reaching the summit and where it is possible to see the remains of World War II military positions;
